profile.headline: Software Engineer at Facebook
profile.summary:
Self-made software specialist, I acquired extensive experience through hands-on development and a passion for understanding the inner-workings of pretty much anything.

A burning desire to succeed pushed me to reach for out-of-my league challenges, proving to be a harsh yet effective way to learn the secrets of the trade.

After years working for both startups and large enterprise provided me with a wide array of challenges in engineering, architecture, team management, budgeting, customer services and release management.

Specialties: Windows 8
Windows Phone
JavaScript & web applications (AJAX, HTML, CSS)
Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF, Silverlight, XAML)
Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)
ASP.NET
C#
Software design and architecture
Team management
Software development cycle and release management

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and implement rapid prototyping stack for pushing richer ads through the monetization back-end.

Design and implement client stack for delivering paid search inventory as rich native ads on publishing partners.

Design and implement real time, low latency back-end components for exploring ad decoration combination, line packing and density.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and implement infrastructure and platform components for the Microsoft Windows 8 applications shipping bundled with the OS.  Work on a shifting platform as Windows nears completion and design solutions around incomplete APIs and unavailable hardware.

Travel to Bellevue, WA and Hyderabad, India frequently to facilitate collaboration between teams, improve cohesion across codebase and drive solution architecture.

Spearhead international tooling effort for support in 100+ languages (including bi-directionality) and create proprietary tools and build systems for application development.

Travel and collaborate with application, Trident and Windows team to improve performance across application suite.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Using the latest technologies to re-invent the search user experience for the Bing clients team.  Working on web and client applications.

Bing - Rich Browse
Create a faceted search page providing users with ways to pivot and filter on interesting dataset.  Support traditional clients as well as new tablets and touch interfaces.

Bing - Trends
Provide users with a dynamic and touch-friendly experience that surfaces trending topics on Bing.  Support traditional clients as well as new tablets and touch interfaces.

positions.title: Tech Lead / Architect
positions.description:
As a technical director, I was tasked with evaluating and selecting technologies used and define development guidance across the company.  Jack of all trades in a small business environnement, I also covered software architect, lead software engineer and project manager (schedules, Q&A and releases) duties.  The company's software is built exclusively using WPF and features an extensible plug in architecture.

Designing and implementing a WPF framework against which products are built.  Greater separation of concerns and independant production schedules between code and XAML projects as well as look-less, localized components.  Developement can be completed and tested prior to the integration of visual composition by the graphics team.

Creating a layered backbone, flexible enough to allow transparent communication over different protocols using WCF services, ADO.NET, XML or unit test stubs.  WCF transactions are aggregated for bandwidth efficiency.

positions.title: Manager - Systems & Processes
positions.description:
As a member of the communication services team, I played an active role in the design, development and implementation of multiple softwares crafted to streamline the acquisition process.

These applications (C#/ASP.NET) connected various enterprise back-bones with the help of customer representatives and automated processes such as submitting orders, acquiring authorizations, billing and scheduling technicians.

They featured in-context editing of an evolving data-model for non-technical business analysts and supported business rules for acquisition and cross-province billing of various assets.

Being a .NET software engineer, I also managed the project's schedules and software life cycle(Q&A and releases).

Guidelines of the projects:
- raising the quality of service level inside the 35 000+ employees company
- reducing operative costs
- maintaining legacy ASP 3.0 applications and mainframe data stores
- extracting the most out of C#, SQL 2k5, SSIS and SSRS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Horaire.net (Schedule.net)
Design and implement scheduling software leveraging partner's optimisation component.  Input and translate constraints and resources to client specific models.  Integrate with existing business solutions like T&A and payroll for major companies like Labatt breweries and Caisse Populaire Desjardins.  Application offered as SaaS through intranet installation.

Product created using ASP.NET (C#), supported by SQL Server.

Kopin
Design and implement re-usable CMS platform for the company's diverse clients.  The architecture allowed for fast release schedules, a requirement considering the large volume of projects.  The whole solution was offered as SaaS, hosted on the company's hardware.

Product created using ASP.NET (C#), supported by SQL Server.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
TMS CRM Solution
Design and implement CRM solution for the company.  The architecture required support for extensions and plugins.  Components created for contact management, messaging and event tracking.

Solution created using ASP.NET (C#), supported by SQL Server.

positions.title: Internship - ASP3 Web Developper
positions.description: Create intranet application reporting results of internal operations using ASP3 scripting, HTML and CSS.
